ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.1 Playtest fixes PathGrid overload resolution and isolates patch installation failures per module, so one incompatible probe no longer disables the whole runtime. Adaptive burst scheduling and Tick/PathFinder/JobGiver profiling remain active. Path/Job state mutation, ReservationManager and whole Pawn ticking remain on the main thread until worker-side snapshot engines are validated.
